name: Northwatch Foothold
summary: Northwatch Foothold is an aggressive Alliance beachhead established in a valley west of Sen'jin Village in Durotar. Originally known as Kolkar Crag, the red canyon now swarms with Kul Tiras sailors and soldiers seeking a permanent military staging ground within Horde borders.

sections.title: A Threat on the Doorstep
sections.body: Carved into the rugged bluffs once known as Kolkar Crag, Northwatch Foothold represents the Alliance's most audacious territorial push into southern Durotar. Human soldiers and naval personnel from Northwatch Hold have occupied the canyon, unloading weapon crates and field rations delivered by icebreaker vessels anchored along the Darkspear Strand. With Razor Hill hard-pressed by quillboar and harpy incursions, the defense of this border falls squarely upon the local Darkspear trolls.

faq.q: What was this place before the humans arrived?
faq.answer: Prior to the human landing, the valley was known as Kolkar Crag and served as an encampment for the local Kolkar centaur clans that roam the arid fringes of Durotar.

faq.q: Where are the Northwatch troops receiving their supplies?
faq.answer: Their logistics run straight through the Darkspear Strand to the south, where two Northwatch icebreakers have anchored offshore to haul ashore crates of provisions, weapons, and construction gear.

faq.q: Why hasn't Razor Hill sent the main army to wipe them out?
faq.answer: The garrison at Razor Hill is currently stretched thin containing Razormane quillboar attacks, Dustwind harpy raids, and Kul Tiras marine scouts further north, leaving Sen'jin Village to counter this threat directly.

faq.q: Who are these humans loyal to?
faq.answer: These troops belong to Northwatch Hold, an Alliance fortress garrisoned primarily by the remnants of the Proudmoore expedition from Kul Tiras who refuse to tolerate a permanent Horde homeland in Kalimdor.

angles.text: The foothold sits right in your backyard, threatening Sen'jin Village directly while your tribe is still struggling to secure a lasting future in Durotar.
For the forces of Northwatch, establishing this fortified canyon is critical to choking Horde movement along the southern coast and protecting supply landings.
